name: Banglalink PPTX Generator
description: Generate Banglalink-branded PowerPoint presentations with per-section AI research, Playwright HTML rendering, and strict brand compliance. Creates professional slide decks following Banglalink's Nov 2025 rebrand guidelines with orange (#F56F1F) theme, Arial typography, and ghost logo placement.
author: Banglalink / AnythingLLM Community

topic.description: The main topic or subject of the presentation

sections.description: Array of section objects, each with title, topic, description, and optional bulletPoints

audience.description: Target audience for the presentation (e.g., 'Senior Management', 'Technical Team')

enableResearch.description: Enable AI web research per section (default: true)
